cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For our quiz debrief, let's start with preparation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's start with geography. I'll make the flashcards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many points did we get?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can keep the score sheet. Give me three countries for next week's practice.

reason: A takes concrete preparation work and gives B score-sheet control while repeatedly steering away from the embarrassing number.
